scope: Independent calibration and motion investigation; no production/CUDA/cost campaign.

calibration_hypotheses.raw: Inherited mass and unit-integral C2 kernel.
calibration_hypotheses.self: Subtract constant B=sum W(lattice at ell)-1/ell^3 at particle sites only; ell=(m/rho)^(1/3). Matching gradient unchanged because B is constant. Physical mass, support, unit integral unchanged.
calibration_hypotheses.ratio: Divide density and matching gradient by D=ell^3 sum W(ell lattice). Discrete normalization control; kernel unit-integral loss recorded, not automatically qualified.
calibration_hypotheses.wallmass: Separately change fixed wall sample volume from m/rho to dx^3; no wall impulse assigned to fluid conservation.

motion_ledger: Every accepted step records K,U,E,linear/angular momentum and signed/positive/negative stage energy changes, correction size, contact/plane activity and velocity reconstruction. Raw p/v every .05 s. Gravity prediction budget independently checked against semi-implicit Euler; stage closure independent at stored observations.

physical_viscosity.equation: rho Dv/Dt=-grad(p)+mu laplacian(v)+rho*g, constant incompressible Newtonian liquid
physical_viscosity.selection: Waterlike and specified viscous model fluid, fixed before runs, not fitted to quiescence or centroid. No global velocity damping.
physical_viscosity.boundaries: Impermeable free-slip walls; no viscous wall drag. Fluid pair strain dissipation, natural free surface.
physical_viscosity.operator: Symmetric central pair strain Laplacian, 2(d+2)=10 factor, physical particle volume m/rho. Linear/angular momentum conserved, rigid rotation has zero strain. Explicit step row-sum bound checked.

criteria.convergence: Physical error must decrease with spatial refinement; strict 1% calibration budget at two finest tested endpoints. Half dt and doubled iterations must preserve physical pass and change centroid <1% target; energy/momentum must remain consistent. A cheap centroid crossing alone is not convergence.

stages.initial_screen: raw vs self vs ratio in deep tank and collision n12; isolated wall-volume n12; raw reference n6 equivalence.
stages.qualification: Self vs raw fixed-geometry spatial n6,12,18,24 if screen finite; deep tank plus static shallow pool; half dt and doubled iterations at n12/18.
stages.motion: Stage ledger on same matched trajectories, late-time restart and mechanism removal only as diagnostic controls if needed; longer tail if wave persistence remains ambiguous.
stages.viscosity: Validate periodic shear and rigid-motion/dissipation/conservation before fluid cases; raw+self with fixed nu at n12 then spatial/time/iteration endpoints for any physical candidate.

durability: Immutable requests; source/binary hashes; scheduled p/v plus complete every-step ledgers; gzip/fsync/raw readback before raw removal. Durable primary home and local evidence copy, checksum manifests and independent mirror verification; failures retained.
